title: code-review CLI request
description: The input contract for `python -m code_review.cli` — the arguments the sub-agent supplies.

analyzers.description: Analyzer ids to run (each maps to --analyzer).

target.description: Target path to analyse (--target). Must be inside CWD.

diff.description: Git diff range to scope analysis (--diff), e.g. HEAD~1..HEAD.

output.description: Output file path (--output). Must be inside CWD for sandbox compatibility.

review_scope.description: Review scope (--review-scope). Defaults to lite when unset.
